title: Nominal and actual damages
summary: A nominal award recognizes breach without proven actual loss; a small actual loss remains compensatory.
notes: White v. Benkowski distinguishes a $1 nominal award from the jury’s $10 for actual inconvenience. Size alone does not determine the category. Pecuniary proof is not the only possible evidence of actual harm. Neither a nominal nor a compensatory award automatically supplies a basis for punitive damages.
